record_purpose: Use the supplied deposited compound-1 crystal structure as the experimental geometry reference.
retrieval_contract: Read the supplied immutable CIF directly. The CCDC record number is provenance only and CCDC database retrieval is not required or scored. Extract the unique organic molecular component, preserve atom labels and Cartesian or fractional coordinates, and record the cell, space group, temperature and any disorder/occupancy information present in the CIF.
allowed_transformations: convert fractional coordinates to Cartesian coordinates using the returned unit cell
select the unique complete organic molecule
add hydrogen atoms only if the record omits them and document the procedure
answer_isolation: This input contains no optimized structure, conformer ranking, orbital energies, target values or comparison tolerances.
